characters.name: Kouko Kaga
characters.description:
She had a perfect future planned with [Mitsuo Yanagisawa](https://anilist.co/character/43671/Yanagisawa-Mitsuo) as her husband, and nothing will get in her way!

She has a side of her that is not violent as Mitsuo has described.

characters.name: Banri Tada
characters.description: Having had an nearly fatal accident shortly after high school graduation, he has lost all memories from before then.  He spent a year recovering, and has now entered Law School.

source.description: Having had an nearly fatal accident shortly after high school graduation, he has lost all memories from before then.  He spent a year recovering, and has now entered Law School.

characters.name: Mitsuo Yanagisawa
characters.description:
__Height:__ 177 cm (5'10")

He tried to escape from Kouko by secretly taking the entrance exams for a private law school in Tokyo. Just when he thought he was free of her at long last, she appeared out of nowhere, having found him out and secretly followed him to the same school.

characters.name: Nana Hayashida
characters.description:
A second year student and Banri and Kouko's senior in the Festival Research Society.  Her nickname Linda (りんだ) is an alternate reading of the kanji for Hayashida (林田).   

~!Banri's love interest and best-friend during High School, she now follows him and keeps an eye out for him, though he cannot remember her at all. For reasons unknown as yet, she has not told him about their shared past.!~

characters.name: Chinami Oka
characters.description: A rather petite girl specializing in film studies, she plays the role of young girls as a voice actor.

characters.name: Takaya Satou
characters.description:
__Height:__ 162cm (5'3")

First year law student. Totally fascinated by two-dimensional girls, he is awkward around three-dimensional (aka real) girls. He has gone so far as to invent his own ideal girl, a two-dimensional creation of his imagination known to him as VJ (Brigitte Jeomillia).
